steps.hardClue: Activate three generators to restore power and raise the submerged machine.
steps.clue: Activate the three AMP Generators to restore power and raise Pack-a-Punch.

steps.hardClue: Open the research room with electrical damage, activate three laptops and solve the equations.
steps.clue: Open the Research Office with Dead Wire, activate the laptops and solve the Resonator equations.

steps.hardClue: Use the resonator at three colored island orbs, then build the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Use the Multiphasic Resonator at the three island orbs, then build the DRI-11 Beamsmasher.

steps.hardClue: Use the Wonder Weapon to recover a hard drive, then free and defeat the prisoner.
steps.clue: Use the Beamsmasher to recover the Hard Drive, find Nathan’s code, then release and defeat him.

steps.hardClue: Use the recovered keycard to enter the wreck and survive the lockdown for two connectors.
steps.clue: Use the Project Janus Keycard to enter the Shipwreck for the Node Connectors.

steps.hardClue: Use the two connectors to repair the network, then collect the hacking device.
steps.clue: Repair two network lines with the Node Connectors, then retrieve the Hacking Device from Peck.

steps.hardClue: Hack three floating transmitters within two minutes.
steps.clue: Hack the three satellite buoys within two minutes.

steps.hardClue: Defuse three explosives in the laboratory within five minutes.
steps.clue: Defuse the three bombs in the Bio Lab within five minutes.

steps.hardClue: Enter the arena and defeat the giant tentacled creature.
steps.clue: Enter the boss arena and defeat Patient 13.
